---
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Ensure act (GitHub Actions runner) is available
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v act > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "act binary not found. Downloading latest release..."
  # Download act for Linux x86_64
  curl -L -o act https://github.com/nektos/act/releases/latest/download/act_Linux_x86_64
  chmod +x act
  # Make it available for the current shell session
  export PATH="$(pwd):$PATH"
else
  echo "act found: $(command -v act)"
fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Run the GitHub Action locally using act
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "=== Running act to trigger the workflow ==="
# Using default options; adjust if you have custom environments
act --verbose

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Verify that check_apt.py was executed and output file exists
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "=== Checking for expected output (apt_output.txt) ==="
OUTPUT_FILE=$(find . -type f -name "apt_output.txt" | head -n 1)

if [[ -n "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "✅ Output file found: $OUTPUT_FILE"
else
  echo "❌ Output file not found."
fi

echo "=== Done ==="

[RUN] bash tools/run_act.sh
[RESULT_CHECK] 命令输出包含 "python check_apt.py" 和 "✅ Output file found" 表示成功。
